Most relevant existing proof pattern is [Pic0RepresentableColimit.lean:28](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0RepresentableColimit.lean:28): `pic0PreservesFilteredBaseColimit_of_representableBy` uses exactly the two scheme factorization/equality lemmas above and `Types.FilteredColimit.isColimitOf'`.

Honest blocker: there is no existing mathlib/project theorem that descends an entire scheme `J_s` or `Scheme.GlueData` from a separably closed field to a finite subextension, nor a generic `baseChange` comparison for `Scheme.GlueData.glued`. The project explicitly documents this gap: chart/overlap ring models exist, but “restriction maps and their cocycle equations remain separate data” ([Pic0FiniteStageAtlas.lean:168-170]), and the critical-path module lists missing finite-stage GlueData descent, glued-scheme base-change comparison, and descent of the universal Picard natural equivalence. Thus the APIs support the final `RepresentableBy` transport once a descended `J_L` plus a natural base-change equivalence are supplied, but they do not construct those objects automatically.
